scope: TG2 joint-integrity worker failure observability and one scheduler-owned retry

observed_failure.issue: The platform API exposes only a generic worker failure and the v2 entrypoint did not persist stdout or stderr to shared storage, so the failed invariant cannot be diagnosed.

change: Keep the admitted integrity script, both verifiers, all inputs, and every acceptance criterion byte-identical.
Run the same integrity script from a new East YAML whose entrypoint tees stdout and stderr to a timestamped shared vePFS log before any preflight or verifier executes.
Use this amendment as the scheduler rearm file and permit one new scheduler-owned East attempt after the failed v2 attempt.
invariants: No checkpoint, sidecar, training recipe, seed, parameter tree, optimizer state, evaluation recipe, scene identity, or result is changed.
No verifier condition is added, removed, weakened, or bypassed.
The integrity completion marker remains absent unless both unchanged verifiers exit successfully.
All nine TG2 evaluations remain blocked until the joint integrity task completes.
